# Vendored build dependency

`tpk_ar-0.2.4-py3-none-any.whl` is a pure-Python wheel built with pip wheel
from the upstream PyPI source distribution, because UnityPy requires this
dependency and PyPI did not provide a wheel. Its upstream license is retained
inside the wheel and the distributed installed metadata.

Source: https://pypi.org/project/tpk-ar/0.2.4/

Source archive: tpk_ar-0.2.4.tar.gz
SHA-256: d64897e5a0bcddd58e8a7d4dd922f372da984a0f98bc3b460ec869aab906ee78

Wheel SHA-256: dd2526e256ce7d4761c47690d6fec2fa14f237a675d78dc0df2470e3dbff2141

The locked builder consumes this exact wheel without executing a source build.
